title: Explicit front/back summands and coproduct components
statement: Let X be a scheme and assume its sheaf-module tensor is additive in both arguments. Let A,B,C be cosimplicial module sheaves and let mu: A tensor B to C be a natural pointwise tensor morphism, using [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-cosimplicial-input]. For integers r,s,n with r+s=n, moduleCup_awSummand is zero when r<0 or s<0. Otherwise identify the zero-extended alternating coface terms with A[r],B[s],C[r+s]; tensor A applied to the simplex inclusion i maps to i and B applied to the inclusion j maps to r+j, then compose with mu in degree r+s and the inverse target identification. moduleCup_awComponent in total degree n is coproduct descent of these maps over r+s=n. Its restriction to every summand is the specified formula, and the formula for r=s=n=0 equals moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroPair.

source.place: Banerjee, Tensor Structure on Smooth Motives, §1.1.4, printed p. 16, front/back formula immediately before (1.1.2).

mathlib_searches.query: Alexander Whitney map from tensor of alternating cosimplicial cochain complexes to pointwise tensor complex
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: alternatingCofaceMapComplex, its obj/map/objD APIs and simplicial analogues. No Alexander--Whitney tensor map or Leibniz formula.
Twelve hits for CosimplicialObject definitions, augmented/truncated objects and colimits. No AW construction or differential identity.
Three hits, all mapBifunctorDesc and ι_mapBifunctorDesc in Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Bifunctor. These assemble degreewise components but do not prove the AW differential identity.

lean.statement:
def moduleCup_awSummand (X : Scheme.{u}) [MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules]
    (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules) (μ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X A B ⟶ C)
    (r s n : ℤ) (h : r + s = n) :
    (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A).X r ⊗
      (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B).X s ⟶ (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X C).X n
